intrusion.name: Intrusion Programs
intrusion.description: Intrusion programs used to bypass security systems and gain unauthorized access.

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.description: Hammer pounds down data walls with a bombardment of raw eletric pulse. It is very noisy and will automatically alert any defense program within 10 spaces.

jackhammer.name: Jackhammer
jackhammer.description: Jackhammer is a quieter but less powerful version of Hammer. It uses small pulses of energy to wear the data wall away.
jackhammer.icon: A glowing red Jackhammer-like object, witch fires a stream of white hot energy at the data wall
